_note: Result shapes for cutlab_jobs.result. media-analysis and the original render entry were captured from live probe jobs on 2026-11-04 (IST). The v2 entries (render with alsoFormats + measurements, transcribe, track, separate) are the contracts implemented by the Lane B parity pass (server/worker.py + job scripts, 2026-11-04); separate currently resolves to the error shape until demucs is installed. The v3 entries (prompt_edit, replicate_analyse) are the contracts implemented by the parked-features pass (server/worker.py + prompt_edit_job.py / replicate_job.py, 2026-11-04); both need supabase/jobs-v3-migration.sql before the relay accepts the job types.

media-analysis._reading: Manifest paths (proxy/thumb/peaks/beats) are relative to outputPrefix inside the cutlab bucket. Full path = outputPrefix + manifest path. An item whose job.json requests include 'beats' gains a beats path (analysis/<stem>.beats.json = {bpm, beats: [{t, tier}]}); on lane failure beats is null and beatsError explains.

render._reading: outputs lists EVERY produced file, main render first; alsoFormats appear as kind 'also-format' with their ratio. measurements carries the loudnorm readings (premix + final output, LUFS / true peak dB). timings is the compositing-vs-encode breakdown.

separate._error: vocal separation unavailable on this server: demucs is not installed (no local free lane). Install with: pip install demucs (about 2 GB incl. torch), then re-queue.
separate._reading: Success shape (demucs installed): per-src stem paths under the job output prefix. TODAY the lane is unavailable, so the job instead ends status 'failed' with error = the clear reason (see _error).

track._reading: keyframesPath points at keyframes.json ({keyframes: [{t, x, y}]} — t clip-local seconds, x/y canvas-px transform offsets). keyframes is inlined when there are <= 120 points. lost counts frames where the tracker held the last position.

transcribe._reading: captions points at the uploaded captions.json ({items: {src: {language, segments: [{start, end, text, words: [{w, t0, t1}]}]}}}); items here is the per-src summary.

prompt_edit._reading: Payload carries the project JSON inline ({version:1, type:'prompt_edit', instruction, project, tokenHash?}) — no media upload. The worker's LLM lane returns {project, summary}; the revised project is schema-validated worker-side AND client-side before the diff preview. Output file jobs/<id>/output/revised.json holds {project, summary, lane}.

result.summary: Moved 3 caption clips to the top of the frame and raised their font size.

prompt_edit.failure: status='failed' with error text (no LLM lane answered / reply failed schema validation / BYO token refused). The editor shows its error state; the project is never half-edited.

replicate_analyse._reading: Payload: {version:1, type:'replicate_analyse', reference: 'jobs/<id>/input/reference_<name>', raws: ['jobs/<id>/input/raw_<name>', ...]} — files uploaded BEFORE the row, same rule as every job. Output jobs/<id>/output/spec.json holds {duration, width, height, segments: [{start, end, cutType, captionText, captionStart, captionEnd, styleNote}], bpm, beats: [seconds], captions: [{start, end, text}]}. All measurements are mechanical (ffmpeg scene detection, librosa beats, faster-whisper phrases); the reference's audio/captions are never copied into a built project.
replicate_analyse.failure: status='failed' with error text (reference over the 60s cap, ffprobe failure, too many raws).
